# Stack Blueprints

> Zero-dependency 5-tier developer stack matrix (Tier 0 `<5 KB` Featherweight to Tier 4 Heavy Enterprise) + workflow file-creation orders, CLI recommender, and AI agent skill.

## Agent Entry Points (All Models)
- `AGENTS.md` — Project guardrails and model-agnostic rules.
- `HANDOFF.md` — Active state, verification command, and next step.
- `mistakes.md` — Permanent "Never Repeat" guardrail log.
- `design-spec/STACK_MATRIX_SPEC.md` — Full 5-tier selection & file-ordering spec.
- `skills/stack-selector/SKILL.md` — Reusable AI agent skill for picking stacks & file orders.

## Key Paths
- `src/stacks.mjs` — Stack tier definitions and workflow file-creation orders (`kickoff`, `feature`, `audit`, `launch`).
- `bin/stack-blueprints.mjs` — Zero-dependency CLI (`list`, `recommend`, `order`).
- `demo/preview.svg` — Visual stack matrix & workflow preview.

## Verification Command
`node bin/stack-blueprints.mjs list && node bin/stack-blueprints.mjs recommend --ram=2 --need=mvp && node bin/stack-blueprints.mjs order kickoff`
